title: papaver hispidum
intro: Papaver hispidum, commonly known as the hairy poppy or Indian poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Papaveraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The health benefits of Papaver hispidum include alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions involve modulating the nervous system and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Papaver hispidum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
